data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for previewing and viewing JSON data with lazy loading.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display JSON data with type highlighting and lazy loading of large lists and maps to prevent jank. It supports custom styling of colors, arrows, and layout.
use_when: You need to display and inspect JSON data inside your Flutter app UI
You are building a debugging or developer tool that needs to render large JSON payloads
avoid_when: You need to generate Dart models or handle complex JSON serialization/deserialization logic
strengths: Lazy loads large lists and maps to maintain good performance
Supports customizable themes, colors, and styling
